name: Hazael
title: The Mighty King of Aram
summary: Hazael was a powerful king of Aram (Syria) who was anointed by the prophet Elisha at God's command, though he seized power by murdering his predecessor Ben-Hadad and became an instrument of God's judgment against Israel. His reign was marked by military expansion and ongoing conflicts with Israel and Judah.

keyEvents.title: Prophesied as King by Elijah
keyEvents.description: God commanded the prophet Elisha to anoint Hazael as king over Aram, as an instrument of judgment against Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Meeting with Elisha
keyEvents.description: Hazael was sent by the sick King Ben-Hadad to the prophet Elisha to ask if he would recover. Elisha prophesied that Hazael would become king and foretold the atrocities he would commit against Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Murder of Ben-Hadad
keyEvents.description: The day after meeting Elisha, Hazael killed King Ben-Hadad by suffocating him with a wet cloth and seized the throne for himself.

keyEvents.title: War Against Israel at Ramoth in Gilead
keyEvents.description: Hazael waged war against King Joram of Israel at Ramoth in Gilead, where Joram was wounded fighting the Arameans.

keyEvents.title: The Oppression of Israel
keyEvents.description: Throughout the reign of King Jehoahaz, Hazael oppressed Israel as part of God's judgment on the people for their sins.

keyEvents.title: Attack on Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Hazael captured Gath and threatened Jerusalem, but King Joash of Judah bought him off with treasures from the temple and royal stores.
